confidence_notes: I ran six searches (one RBA FX, five Lugano price checks) and read search-result summaries only, not full pages. Beer (about CHF 6-6.5), cappuccino (about CHF 3.5-4) and the inexpensive meal (about CHF 25) rest on crowdsourced aggregators in the results (mylifeelsewhere.com, expatistan.com, combien-coute.net). Some of that data may be dated, so I rounded beer and coffee up slightly. The mid-range meal for two is bounded from Lugano Region set-menu and lunch-menu prices, because no direct three-course-for-two index surfaced. The cocktail uses expatistan's CHF 14 club figure and a CHF 15-20 nightlife-guide range (about 2.3x beer). No Lugano wine-by-the-glass price was found, so wine is set at about 1.3x beer, checked against Swiss alpine menu prices. CHF was converted to USD at an assumed ~1.25 USD per CHF, not a live rate. Accommodation anchors are holistic July high-season estimates from general knowledge; I searched no accommodation prices or live listings, so they are the least certain. FX is the 18 Nov 2026 rate shown in search-result text for the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Lugano-specific aggregator snippets. Accommodation, and the wine-to-beer ratio, are holistic comparisons with Swiss lake-resort cities such as Lucerne and Locarno in July high season. Lugano sits slightly below Zurich/Geneva price levels, with Italian-Swiss café and wine culture.
